fields.subject: ShardKeySerialization
fields.trigger: a key column whose .NET type is an enum is encoded via GetKeyDataType and later reconstructed via GetArgType
fields.response: recover only the enum's underlying primitive type (int, byte, short, or long) -- not the original enum type
fields.postcondition: GhostShardKey.GetInstance resolves that same GetArgType mapping when it selects the generic type argument for a reflective ShardKey<...> construction, so for a key whose stored metadata code is one of the four *Enum codes, the Type argument it supplies to Activator.CreateInstance is always the underlying primitive, never the original enum type; this records only which Type argument GhostShardKey selects, not that the resulting Activator.CreateInstance call succeeds or that the constructed object is otherwise usable
